signature: SUBROUTINE DLATRZ( M, N, L, A, LDA, TAU, WORK )

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix A. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: L
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix A containing the meaningful part of the Householder vectors. $N-M \ge L \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the leading M-by-N upper trapezoidal part of the array A must contain the matrix to be factorized. On exit, the leading M-by-M upper triangular part of A contains the upper triangular matrix R, and elements N-L+1 to N of the first M rows of A, with the array `TAU`, represent the orthogonal matrix Z as a product of M elementary reflectors.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: TAU
params.reference: The scalar factors of the elementary reflectors.
